title: A lower bound on the Calabi functional for a degeneration of polarized varieties
summary: We prove a lower bound on the Calabi functional for degenerations of polarized varieties, involving the difference of CM degrees between generically isomorphic families. This may be viewed as a discretely valued version of Donaldson's lower bound for models, in the sense of non-Archimedean geometry. In particular, this generalizes a result of Donaldson, who considered a single polarized variety.
